name: Get DPAPI System (SA)
help: Extract the DPAPI_SYSTEM LSA secret (requires high integrity/elevation)
long_help: Extracts the DPAPI_SYSTEM machine key from the LSA secrets registry. This key can decrypt DPAPI-protected data for the SYSTEM account and all users on the machine. Requires high integrity (elevated) context. Temporarily modifies registry ACLs to read protected keys, then restores original permissions.
